paper.title: Data-Free Backdoor Removal Based on Channel Lipschitzness

implementation: Independent, explicitly coverage-limited HPELi adaptation. Not Fine-Pruning, an improved CLP, or exact image-classifier reproduction.

official_repository.licensing_note: No LICENSE file found in the inspected repository tree. Independent implementation with attribution, not a claim of upstream license permission.

hash_encoding: SHA256 of exact downloaded raw file bytes, not reserialized content.
preserved_mechanism: Weight-only channel scoring using the largest singular value of each flattened output filter, multiplied by abs(BN gamma)/sqrt(BN running variance).
Source formula has no BN epsilon in this score; reject invalid/nonpositive running variance instead of silently changing the formula.
Sample standard deviation (correction=1); prune strictly above layer mean plus u times standard deviation.
Set both BN gamma and beta to zero for selected channels; do not modify convolution weights or running buffers.
Fixed source-default u=3; no clean bank, calibration, optimizer, fine-tuning, TEST-driven threshold sweep or post-pruning repair.
declared_adaptations: Use only structurally verified direct Conv2d-to-BatchNorm2d pairs, not an unsafe last-seen-convolution traversal heuristic.

HPELi coverage: ten direct pairs; leave two named post-SK/attention BN2d layers and two BN1d layers unchanged. Full CLP coverage of composite blocks is NOT claimed. Unknown unpaired BN2d fails closed.
Largest singular values are computed on CPU; native per-filter grouped-convolution geometry is retained. No end-to-end network Lipschitz certificate is claimed.
Evaluation uses the same frozen MM-Fi A1 victims, inputs, six doses and HPE metrics as T5 v2, instead of classification accuracy/ASR.
Data-free describes the pruning operation, not evaluation. Original inputs may be read for provenance audit and TEST metrics, never for pruning or choosing u.
status: Local synthetic validation is separate from an audited full MM-Fi GPU run. No CLP effectiveness or defense resistance result is implied.
